with source as (
    select * from "postgres"."public"."raw_transactions"
),
cleaned as (
    select 
        date,
        merchant,
        category,
        cast(amount as decimal(10,2)) as amount,
        is_credit
        from source
        where amount > 0
)
select * from cleaned

with source as (
    select * from "postgres"."public_public"."stg_transactional" 
),
cleaned as (
    select 
        cast(date as date) as transaction_date,
        date_trunc('month', cast(date as date)) as transaction_month,
        date_trunc('year', cast(date as date)) as transaction_year,
        EXTRACT(DOW FROM cast(date as date))::int as day_of_week,
        lower(trim(merchant)) as merchant_name,
        lower(trim(category)) as category_name,
        abs(amount) as amount,
        case when is_credit = True then 'credit' else 'debit' end as transaction_type,
        count(*) over ( partition by date, merchant, amount) as duplicate_count
        from 
            source
        where   
            amount is not null 
            and amount > 0
            and merchant is not null
            and date is not null    
),
final as (
    select 
    transaction_date,
    transaction_month,
    transaction_year,
    day_of_week,
    merchant_name,
    category_name,
    amount,
    transaction_type,
    duplicate_count,
    case when duplicate_count>1 then 1 else 0 end as is_potential_duplicate
    from 
    cleaned
)

select * from final

with transactions as (
    select * from "postgres"."public_public"."int_transactions_cleaned"
    where transaction_type = 'debit'
),
category_stats as (
    select
        category_name,
    avg(amount) as category_mean,
    stddev(amount) as category_sd,
    count(*) as category_count
    from 
        transactions
    group by category_name
),
transactions_with_stats as (
    select 
    t.*,
    c.category_mean,
    c.category_sd,
    c.category_count
    from 
        transactions t
    left join
        category_stats c
    on c.category_name = t.category_name
),
anomaly_detection as (
    select 
        transaction_date,
        merchant_name,
        category_name,
        amount,
        category_mean,
        category_sd,
        category_count,
        case when category_sd is not null and category_sd>0
        then round((amount-category_mean)/category_sd,2) else null end as z_score,
        case when category_sd is not null and category_sd>0 and abs((amount-category_mean)/category_sd)>2 then True
        when category_count = 1 and amount>500 then True
        else False end as anomaly_flag,
        case when category_sd is not null and category_sd>0 and abs((amount-category_mean)/category_sd)>2 then 'High zscore: significantly above category average'
        when category_count = 1 and amount>500 then 'Single large transaction in category'
        else 'Normal' end as anomaly_reason
    from
        transactions_with_stats
),
final as (
    select  
        transaction_date,
        merchant_name,
        category_name,
        round(amount,2) as amount,
        round(category_mean,2) as category_mean,
        round(category_sd,2) as category_sd,
        z_score,
        anomaly_flag,
        anomaly_reason
    from 
        anomaly_detection
)
select * from final
order by anomaly_flag desc, z_score desc nulls last

with transactions as (
    select * from "postgres"."public_public"."int_transactions_cleaned"
    where transaction_type = 'debit'
),
monthly_category as (
    select 
        transaction_month,
        category_name,
        count(*) as transaction_count,
        sum(amount) as total_spend,
        avg(amount) as avg_spending,
        min(amount) as min_transaction,
        max(amount) as max_transaction,
        round(sum(amount)/sum(sum(amount)) over(
            partition by transaction_month)*100,2) as pct_monthly_spend
        from    
            transactions
        group by
             transaction_month,
             category_name       
        ),
final as (
    select 
        transaction_month,
        category_name,
        transaction_count,
        round(total_spend,2) as total_spend,
        round(avg_spending,2) as avg_spending,
        round(min_transaction,2) as min_transaction,
        round(max_transaction,2) as max_transaction,
        pct_monthly_spend
        from 
            monthly_category
)    
select * from final
order by 
    transaction_month desc,
    total_spend desc

with transactions as (
    select * from "postgres"."public_public"."int_transactions_cleaned"
    where transaction_type = 'debit'
),
monthly_summary as (
    select 
        transaction_month,
        count(*) as total_transactions,
        round(sum(amount),2) as total_spend,
        round(avg(amount),2) as avg_transactions,
        round(max(amount),2) as largest_transactions,
        sum(is_potential_duplicate) potential_duplicates
    from 
        transactions
    group by    
        transaction_month           
),
final as (
    select
        transaction_month,
        total_transactions,
        total_spend,
        avg_transactions,
        largest_transactions,
        potential_duplicates,
        round(total_spend - lag(total_spend) over(order by transaction_month),2) as mom_spend_change,
        round((total_spend - lag(total_spend) over(order by transaction_month))/nullif(lag(total_spend) over(order by transaction_month),0)
        *100,2) as mom_spend_pct_change
    from 
        monthly_summary
)
select * from final
order by transaction_month
